title: start re-wakes a dead relay while the database proxy's face is up
intention: The database proxy's shim reads 'running' as the relay being alive, not as its face being up: `cairn database start`, and the db client's bus wake that sends it, re-wakes a relay that died under a live face, and says 'already running' only while the relay listens.
why: Measured 2026-11-18 on akienlivingroom at 7c07ae3a4 (live-fire of 9166782e6101): with the face up, the relay was killed and 5432 had 0 listeners; `cairn database start` answered 'database already running' while `show status hot` read state stopped, and store.connect() raised 'still refused 60s after waking the database proxy'. A relay crash under a live face is the case the wake exists for, and it stayed down until a hand ran stop then start.
traces_to: Law 7 (a status surface must not say running over a dead relay) and outline 11.3.7 (every box reaches its database through its own proxy).
how: DatabaseProxyShim overrides the running property: the base presence AND the face's state() reading 'listening' (state() already reads a dead pid as stopped). It overrides _ensure_device: with the face down it defers to the base (construction is the wake); with the face up it calls the face's wake(). The base resolver's start branch is unchanged.

clauses.claim: with the face up and the relay's recorded pid dead, `start` calls the face's wake() and says 'started database', never 'already running'
with the face up and the relay alive, `start` says 'already running' and wakes nothing
with the face down, `start` brings the face up, whose construction is the wake

decisions.text: D1: dbproxy/shim.py: running requires the face's state() to read listening; _ensure_device re-wakes a live face.

D2: the proof drives the shim's resolve(['start']) over a face whose record and wake are recorders, one tooth per clause, shaped like cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_an_unanswered_clearance_is_not_a_refusal.py.

out: stop with no face up (its own ticket)

measured.saw: face up, relay killed: start said 'database already running', show status hot read stopped, store.connect() still refused after 60 s
measured.how: akienlivingroom_cc_0 killed relay pid 8452 and its launcher, then ran cairn database start and store.connect() at 7c07ae3a4

orient.request: make cairn database start re-wake the relay when it died while the database proxy's face stayed up
orient.intent: DatabaseProxyShim reads running as the relay listening, and start re-wakes a live face whose relay is dead.
orient.scope: IN: dbproxy/shim.py, one dbproxy proof. OUT: the base shim's resolver, device.py's wake, stop with no face up, every other component.

constraints.text: with the face up and the relay's recorded pid dead, start calls the face's wake() and says 'started database'
the base resolver's start branch is unchanged
the database proxy is the one door a box's processes reach their database by

holdings.what: state() reading a dead pid as stopped; wake() spawning when not listening
a proof whose teeth each report red or green

absences.what: a shim whose running reads the relay
absences.measure: 2026-11-18: dbproxy/shim.py defines no running and no _ensure_device; start answered 'already running' on akienlivingroom over 0 listeners

absences.what: a proof driving start over a face whose relay died
absences.measure: ls cairn/devices/dbproxy/proofs held only test_the_database_proxy_forwards_to_postgres.py, which never kills a relay under a live face

sub_problems.fills: a proof driving start over a face whose relay died

sub_problems.fills: a shim whose running reads the relay
